_about: Story line gates for the screen probe (story levels 1-5). A gate says what the player must not have seen yet (unseen) or must be able to see (seen) when a caption whose text contains `line` (case-insensitive) is up, and which earlier lines must already have played (after: substrings of their text). Ids must match things[].id from window.R.snap(). beforeGoal / afterGoal (objective ids) require a line while a goal is not yet done, or only once it is done. Add a gate whenever a script line asks about or points at something, or answers an earlier line. Every caption line of levels 1-5 has a gate (outpost-ops#380); the checks warn, they never fail the train.
